attempts.summary: Configured PAM-based password quality enforcement on node1 (Alpine 3.23): installed shadow (PAM-linked passwd), linux-pam, and libpwquality; set minlen=12, minclass=3, enforce_for_root in /etc/security/pwquality.conf; created /etc/pam.d/passwd and /etc/pam.d/base-password wiring pam_pwquality (requisite) before pam_unix in the password stack. Verified enforcement rejects passwords under 12 chars or with fewer than 3 character classes, and accepts compliant ones. Restarted node1 via native reboot, confirmed boot_id changed (12091ac7... -> e74e2610...), and re-verified both config persistence and live enforcement behavior post-reboot with a fresh test user (cleaned up afterward).
